judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), a spec update (`specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`), and an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/usageAcrossToolRounds.acceptance.test.ts`), without actually modifying `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because the implementation is completely missing, the new acceptance tests will fail immediately against the unedited `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` logic. Furthermore, the candidate failed to update the hook signature parameter name (`totalUsage`) and did not add the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry. While the test cases and spec edits align conceptually with the ticket, the core feature was never implemented.
